releaseNotes: v1.7.0: The dashboard becomes a Portfolio home with a new light palette. Four counts show projects behind schedule, billing ahead of work, documents waiting approval and projects due in 30 days (tap one to filter the list). A Needs attention list ranks overdue, slipping, unapproved and stale projects, and every project row shows work done against billed. Light or Dark can be picked from the account menu.
